column1: # Third-party files committed directly into this repository.
# Everything else in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md is generated by reading package
# metadata out of the built images. These files have no such metadata — no
# apt, pip or npm knows about them — so their licences are recorded by hand
# here and rendered into the generated file from this manifest.
# scripts/gen-notice.sh ENFORCES COMPLETENESS: it scans the tree for vendored
# files and FAILS if it finds one that is not declared below. That is the point
# of this file. The failure mode it prevents is someone dropping a minified
# library into vendor/ and nobody noticing that the repository now redistributes
# it. Hand-authored data, machine-checked coverage.
# Unlike the generated inventory, these are distributed by the SOURCE
# repository, so the obligation applies the moment the repo is published —
# before any image exists.
# UNKNOWN in the version column is deliberate: it means the artifact carries no
# determinable version and a human must confirm it against upstream before
# publishing. Do not fill these in by guessing.
# path<TAB>name<TAB>version<TAB>licence<TAB>upstream
frontend-react/public/vendor/fonts/plex-sans-var.woff2
frontend-react/public/vendor/fonts/plex-mono-400.woff2
frontend-react/public/vendor/fonts/plex-mono-500.woff2
frontend-react/public/vendor/fonts/plex-mono-600.woff2
# The onvif_wsdl/ bundle is NOT one work. It carries files from three separate
# rights holders, and attributing all twelve to ONVIF — as this manifest did
# until 2026-08-27 — was wrong for nine of them. Split by the organisation that
# actually holds the copyright, identified from each file's targetNamespace and
# its own notice.
# Modification scope: NONE. As of 2026-08-28 all twelve files are byte-identical
# to their upstream URLs, re-fetched and diffed that day.
# They were not always. Until 2026-08-28 seven of them carried rewritten
# schemaLocation attributes (absolute URLs → local filenames) so the SOAP client
# could resolve the bundle without network access. That made us a redistributor
# of MODIFIED specification texts from three rights holders whose licences are
# notice-and-disclaimer grants written for specifications, not software — the
# weakest available position, on the least necessary point. The localisation now
# lives in backend/services/onvif_wsdl_transport.py, which maps the upstream URLs
# to these files inside zeep's Transport.load(). Code we own; documents we ship
# unaltered.
# The 2026-08-27 note this replaces recorded "three identical, nine differing".
# The re-fetch found FIVE identical and SEVEN differing. Re-run the diff whenever
# these files are refreshed; do not carry the counts forward on trust.
services/camera-mgmt/backend/onvif_wsdl/onvif.xsd
